title: I made a Brawl Stars-ish browser game 😂  Eight fighters and multiplayer.
author: geekytwerp
selftext:
I made a game because apparently playing them wasn’t enough.

I wanted something with a bit of Brawl Stars energy that I could open in a browser and play with friends. So I built Skill Rivals using Codex

It has eight fighters and multiplayer now. I’m still figuring out what’s fun and what needs fixing.

That’s what I’ve enjoyed most about building lately: having an idea, making it real, then seeing if I actually want to use it.

Try a match and tell me who you picked. Honest feedback please 😂

[https://skillrivals.com/](https://skillrivals.com/)
